patch_description: Replace the hard hold (keep=0.0) in the guarded reversal damping with a magnitude-proportional quadratic soft damp: out[k] = out[k-1] + d*(1 - (|d|/thresh)^2) for sub-threshold flips. The hard hold creates flat zero-step segments that inflate avg_error/lag while leaving residual flips from the mirrored backward sweep re-introducing what the forward sweep removed. The quadratic falloff pins tiny flips to (nearly) zero while passing near-threshold steps almost intact, so a single unguarded sweep pair suffices — no guard retry escalation (which previously halted smoothing too early at the 0.97 correlation check). Guard instead with a single hard abort: correlation against the original input slice must stay >= 0.93, otherwise revert to the pre-damp signal. All sanitization and the rest of the pipeline remain untouched.
